correctness.rationale: Complete three-selected-point extension lemma: every possible fourth-point equality, sort and ternary M diagram is determined solely by the old atomic diagram for Latin squares of order at least four. Cases of distinct/fused completions in one or two concurrent triples require at most four symbols. Four-round EF equivalence follows; unique small Latin squares of orders 1,2,3 and row-counting sentences give exact lower classes; explicitly rank-five sentence with four outer variables and one nested existential separates cyclic and Klein-four group tables. Exhaustive Python checks on 60 reduced Latin squares and independent C++ exact EF recursion agree; arbitrary orders rest on proof, not computation.

value.rationale: A complete theorem for all finite Latin squares, uniform across arbitrary isotopy and unbounded sizes, isolates the exact rank at which three-sorted incidence logic begins to detect structure beyond cardinality. The rank-five explicit C4/V4 separation is sharp and distinguishes quantifier depth from raw number of quantifiers, a meaningful boundary for logical expressiveness on transversal designs. Not a mere fixed-order enumeration.
